top_signals.title: Mexican Peso Rout Deepens as Banxico, Fed Policies Diverge
top_signals.summary: The Mexican peso sank past the 19-per-dollar mark to its lowest in over a year, as the prospect of further Federal Reserve interest-rate hikes intensified a selloff triggered by Mexico’s dovish monetary policy.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
